sql: SELECT b.name AS marca, COUNT(st.id) AS numero_lojas FROM brands b JOIN stores st ON st.brand_id = b.id GROUP BY b.name
SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao FROM sales s WHERE s.sold_at >= '2025-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-01-01'
SELECT st.name AS loja, COUNT(e.id) AS funcionarios FROM employees e JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id GROUP BY st.name
SELECT payment_method AS metodo_pagamento, ROUND(SUM(total), 2) AS faturacao FROM sales WHERE sold_at >= '2026-11-18' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY faturacao DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT st.name AS loja, SUM(sl.quantity) AS quantidade FROM sale_lines sl JOIN sales s ON s.id = sl.sale_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY quantidade DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.total), 2) AS ticket_medio FROM sales s
SELECT name AS produto, price AS preco, unit_cost AS custo, margin_pct AS margem_pct FROM product_margins ORDER BY margin_pct DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(p.id) AS compras_por_receber FROM purchases p JOIN suppliers su ON su.id = p.supplier_id JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = p.warehouse_id WHERE p.status = 'encomendada'
SELECT COUNT(t.transfer_id) AS numero_transferencias FROM transfers t WHERE t.transfer_date >= '2026-01-01' AND t.transfer_date < '2027-01-01'

SELECT i.name AS ingrediente, i.unit AS unidade, ROUND(SUM(sk.quantity * il.unit_cost), 2) AS custo_total, ROUND(SUM(sk.quantity * p.price), 2) AS preco_total FROM stock sk JOIN ingredients i ON i.id = sk.ingredient_id JOIN products p ON p.id = sk.product_id GROUP BY i.name, i.unit ORDER BY preco_total / i.unit DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY faturacao DESC

SELECT ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.end_time - sh.start_time)) / 3600), 2) AS horas FROM shifts sh JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id WHERE st.name ILIKE 'BurgerLab Maia' AND sh.shift_date >= '2026-10-01' AND sh.shift_date < '2026-11-01'
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(s.id) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN s.payment_method = 'mbway' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS taxa_mbway FROM sales s WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2027-01-01'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-10-31' EXCEPT SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-09-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-10-01'

SELECT m.name AS menu, SUM(sl.quantity) AS quantidade FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menus m ON m.id = sl.menu_id JOIN sales s ON s.id = sl.sale_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY m.name ORDER BY quantidade DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(sl.quantity) AS quantidade FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id JOIN sales s ON s.id = sl.sale_id WHERE p.name ILIKE 'Pastel de nata' AND s.sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-11-01'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(sk.quantity), 3) AS quantidade, i.unit AS unidade FROM stock sk JOIN ingredients i ON i.id = sk.ingredient_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = sk.store_id WHERE st.city ILIKE 'São Paulo' EXCEPT SELECT ROUND(SUM(sk.quantity), 3) AS quantidade, i.unit AS unidade FROM stock sk JOIN ingredients i ON i.id = sk.ingredient_id JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = sk.warehouse_id WHERE w.city ILIKE 'São Paulo' GROUP BY i.unit

SELECT w.name AS armazem, ROUND(SUM(sk.quantity), 3) AS quantidade, i.unit AS unidade FROM stock sk JOIN ingredients i ON i.id = sk.ingredient_id JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = sk.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.name, i.unit

SELECT b.name AS marca, COUNT(t.transfer_id) AS numero_transferecimentos FROM stores st JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id JOIN transfers t ON t.store_id = st.id WHERE st.opened_at >= '2026-01-01' AND st.opened_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY b.name

SELECT ROUND(SUM(pl.quantity * i.unit_cost), 2) AS valor_total FROM purchase_lines pl JOIN ingredients i ON i.id = pl.ingredient_id JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = pl.supplier_id WHERE p.status = 'recebida' AND p.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND p.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'

SELECT s.payment_method AS metodo_pagamento, ROUND(AVG(s.total), 2) AS talao_medio FROM sales s WHERE s.sold_at >= '2025-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY s.payment_method ORDER BY talao_medio DESC
SELECT b.name AS marca, COUNT(e.id) AS funcionarios FROM employees e JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id GROUP BY b.name
SELECT ROUND(AVG(e.hourly_rate), 2) AS salario_medio FROM employees e WHERE e.role ILIKE 'Barista'

SELECT date_trunc('month', s.sold_at)::date AS mes, ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id WHERE st.name ILIKE 'BurgerLab Maia' AND s.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY mes ORDER BY mes

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM s.sold_at) AS hora, COUNT(sl.sale_id) AS numero_taloes FROM sale_lines sl JOIN sales s ON s.id = sl.sale_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id WHERE st.name ILIKE 'Café Aroma Porto' AND s.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY hora ORDER BY numero_taloes DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.total) / SUM(s.total) FILTER (WHERE '2026-09-01' <= s.sold_at AND s.sold_at < '2026-10-01'), 2) AS faturacao_setembro, ROUND(SUM(s.total) / SUM(s.total) FILTER (WHERE '2026-10-01' <= s.sold_at AND s.sold_at < '2026-11-01'), 2) AS faturacao_outubro, ROUND((SUM(s.total) / SUM(s.total) FILTER (WHERE '2026-10-01' <= s.sold_at AND s.sold_at < '2026-11-01')) / (SUM(s.total) / SUM(s.total) FILTER (WHERE '2026-09-01' <= s.sold_at AND s.sold_at < '2026-10-01')), 2) AS crescimento FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id WHERE '2026-09-01' <= s.sold_at AND s.sold_at < '2026-11-01'

SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND(SUM(s.total) / (SELECT SUM(s.total) FROM sales s), 4) * 100 AS percentual_receita FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY percentual_receita DESC

SELECT b.name AS marca, st.name AS loja, ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY b.name, st.name ORDER BY faturacao DESC LIMIT 2

SELECT ROUND(SUM(sk.quantity * (sl.unit_price - pm.unit_cost)), 2) AS margem_total_euros FROM sale_lines sk JOIN sales s ON s.id = sk.sale_id JOIN product_margins pm ON pm.product_id = sk.product_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-11-01'

SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND(SUM(pm.unit_margin), 2) AS margem_total FROM product_margins pm JOIN brands b ON b.id = pm.brand_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY margem_total DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT b.name AS marca, COUNT(pr.name) AS numero_produtos FROM price_recommendations pr JOIN brands b ON b.id = pr.brand_id WHERE pr.classification ILIKE 'cão' GROUP BY b.name

SELECT p.name AS produto, r.price AS preco, i.unit AS unidade FROM price_recommendations r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id JOIN ingredients i ON i.id = r.ingredient_id WHERE r.classification ILIKE 'estrela'

SELECT st.name AS loja, ROUND((SUM(s.total) - SUM(s.total_2025)) / SUM(s.total_2025) * 100, 2) AS crescimento FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2025-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY crescimento DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND(SUM(e.hourly_rate * sh.hours), 2) AS custo_funcionarios FROM employees e JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id WHERE st.opened_at <= '2026-10-31' AND st.opened_at >= '2026-10-01' GROUP BY b.name

SELECT p.name AS produto, SUM(sl.quantity) AS quantidade FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id WHERE s.sold_at >= '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY quantidade DESC LIMIT 1
